QUOTE: "`MBEDTLS_PRIVATE(member)` expands to `private_##member`... The field is still there under the mangled name... It does not change the struct layout, so the ABI is the same either way."
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer states opacity is enforced at compile time by renaming members (naming guard, not access control), with the struct layout unchanged and fields still present.
